boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named, map-listed destinations along Pacific Coast Highway and adjacent Civic Center corridors near Pepperdine’s Malibu campus.

cards.title: Malibu Bluffs Park
cards.subtitle: Pacific Coast Highway–Malibu Canyon Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the jogging path, picnic tables, playground, and whale-watching station during the park’s daily open hours; bring what you need for an outdoor stop.
cards.short_summary: A city park with ocean-facing recreation facilities beside Malibu Canyon Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Malibu Bluffs Park at Pacific Coast Highway and Malibu Canyon Road with trails, picnic tables, a playground, a whale-watching station, and daily 8 AM-to-sunset hours.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 8 AM to sunset; facilities may be subject to City notices.

cards.title: Legacy Park
cards.subtitle: Civic Center Way corridor
cards.notes: Follow the pedestrian walkways and pause at the scenic overlook; this works well as a daylight loop paired with the nearby library.
cards.short_summary: A natural landscaped civic park with linked coastal habitats and pedestrian paths.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Legacy Park at 23500 Civic Center Way, describes four linked coastal habitats there, and lists it open daily from 8 AM to sunset.

cards.title: Malibu Library
cards.subtitle: Civic Center Way corridor
cards.notes: Settle into a reading or research session, then look for the local-history displays and public art incorporated into the renovated library interior.
cards.short_summary: A public library with reading, research, meeting, and local-history space.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Malibu Library at 23519 W. Civic Center Way and says its floor plan provides reading, research, meeting, and local-history space.
cards.access_notes: City-listed library hours: Mon–Thu 10 AM–8 PM, Fri–Sat 9 AM–5 PM, Sun 1–5 PM.

cards.title: Malibu City Gallery
cards.subtitle: Stuart Ranch Road corridor at Malibu City Hall
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before going, then visit the gallery on City Hall’s first floor during its weekday public hours.
cards.short_summary: A rotating municipal gallery with several Arts Commission exhibitions each year.
cards.evidence_claim: The Malibu Arts Commission curates four to six annual exhibitions at Malibu City Gallery in City Hall, 23825 Stuart Ranch Road; the City says attendance is free.
cards.source_title: Malibu City Gallery and Art Exhibitions
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 8 AM–4 PM, according to the City; confirm exhibition dates before travel.

cards.title: Malibu Country Mart
cards.subtitle: Cross Creek Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the complex as a clear Cross Creek waypoint, then choose a shop or food stop that fits your time and budget.
cards.short_summary: A named Cross Creek commercial destination documented on the City’s walking-tour map.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Malibu’s walking-tour site key identifies Malibu Country Mart at 3835 Cross Creek Road.
cards.source_title: Malibu Civic Center Walking Tour Site Key and Map
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours and purchase terms.

cards.title: Malibu Village
cards.subtitle: Cross Creek Road corridor
cards.notes: Browse the posted directory first so you can make one deliberate stop for books, apparel, food, wellness, or a practical errand.
cards.short_summary: A Cross Creek retail and service cluster with a published tenant directory.
cards.evidence_claim: Malibu Village’s official directory lists shops, restaurants, wellness, and services at 3836 Cross Creek Road in Malibu.
cards.access_notes: Consult individual tenant listings for current hours and availability.

cards.title: Malibu Lagoon State Beach
cards.subtitle: Pacific Coast Highway–Cross Creek Road corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Cross Creek Road for the nature area, then take the trails slowly for lagoon and beach views while respecting posted habitat rules.
cards.short_summary: A state beach where Malibu Creek reaches the Pacific, with trails and wildlife viewing.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks says Malibu Lagoon State Beach has nature trails, bird-watching, lagoon views, and beach access, with parking/nature-area entry at Cross Creek Road.
cards.access_notes: Day-use parking is listed 8 AM–sunset; parking fees apply. Dogs are not allowed on lagoon trails or the beach.

cards.title: Adamson House
cards.subtitle: Pacific Coast Highway corridor beside Malibu Lagoon
cards.notes: See the historic house and its Malibu tile details, or time a visit for the adjoining museum and grounds; check weather-related closures first.
cards.short_summary: A California State Parks historic house and museum destination beside the lagoon.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks identifies Adamson House at 23200 Pacific Coast Highway and describes its historic house, grounds, Malibu tile, and adjoining Malibu Lagoon Museum.
cards.access_notes: The State Parks page says the museum is free, Wednesday–Saturday 11 AM–3 PM; house/museum closures can occur during rain.

cards.title: Malibu Pier
cards.subtitle: Pacific Coast Highway corridor
cards.notes: Walk the publicly open portion for the landmark structure and coastal views, and check the State Parks closure notice before planning a full-length stroll.
cards.short_summary: A historic oceanfront pier with current access limited at its far end.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks reports that the rest of Malibu Pier remains open to the public while its end is temporarily closed for structural safety concerns.
cards.source_title: FAQs: Temporary Closure of the End of Malibu Pier
cards.access_notes: The far end remains temporarily closed; review the State Parks update before visiting.

cards.title: Malibu Equestrian Park
cards.subtitle: Merritt Drive–Morning View Drive corridor
cards.notes: If you already ride, use the public practice and recreational-riding access; otherwise, stop by only when an authorized lesson or event is available.
cards.short_summary: A public equestrian facility with two riding arenas next to Malibu High School.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Malibu Equestrian Park at 6225 Merritt Drive with two riding arenas, picnic area, restrooms, and public practice/recreational-riding access.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 8 AM to sunset; horse shows and lessons use facility-rental arrangements.
